decisions.reason: This secure document-storage feature fits the firm's identity and security knowledge base, so management is likely to retain it as an adjacent platform feature despite still-limited market evidence.
An identity-bound payment wallet combines two of the firm's core competences, digital identity and payments, which makes it highly learnable and commercially relevant for its target sectors.

Although login authentication is close to the firm's expertise, the NFC-tag format is more niche and somewhat less central to its software-platform direction, raising but not overturning the chance of withdrawal.
A secure payment and wallet framework sits squarely within the firm's established integrated security and payment capabilities and therefore benefits strongly from absorptive capacity.
This product is the firm's stated flagship and directly expresses its strategic move toward secure super-app ecosystems, so management would be very unlikely to take it off the market.
An application-shielding security library is tightly aligned with the firm's long-standing application-security expertise and is likely to be kept as a reusable core technology asset.
